counterfactual_missing_items: Negative fungal culture on Sabouraud dextrose agar
Absence of systemic complaints or high-risk behavior for HIV
decisive_items: Many histiocytes and giant cells contained intracellular yeasts with a surrounding halo
Special stains (Grocott-Gomori methenamine-silver nitrate and periodic acid–Schiff) highlighted fungal forms
response.rationale: The presence of intracellular yeasts within histiocytes and the highlighting of fungal forms by special stains strongly support the diagnosis of Histoplasmosis, despite the negative fungal culture.

rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence for oral ulcerative lesions beyond the presence of a nonhealing ulcer.
The absence of underlying induration, friability, or bleeding on manipulation contradicts the typical presentation of squamous cell carcinoma.
The candidate is an append-only completion and lacks independent supporting evidence.
